name: Neon social preview card by neon.tech
description: A 1200630 OG card on a near-black canvas with abstract vertical neon bars in green, teal and amber glowing across the top two-thirds, like data streams or an equalizer. The logo lockup sits top-left, a small red kicker line ('A Databricks company') with a tiny icon sits above a two-line white headline in a clean sans, bottom-left aligned. The composition is asymmetric and calm: bright abstract texture upper-right, quiet dark space lower-left for the type.
